Name:
A$AP Mob - Hella Hoes [V1]
(with A$AP Rocky, A$AP Ferg, A$AP Twelvvy, A$AP NAST, Danny Brown & A$ton Matthews) (prod. Nyrell)
Notes: On A$AP Yams' Tumblr he shared a video of an early version of the song "Hella Hoes" with the original features of Danny Brown and A$ton Matthews. This version also features different verse arrangements as A$ton Matthews goes after A$AP Twelvvy's verse instead of Rocky. The two artists that were originally featured on the song were eventually taken off, and this caused a small feud between the A$AP Mob and Danny Brown as when the official song released he talked about how he was cut off the song. Danny expressed that he recorded for the song while on the road so he had to pay for the studio time. Eventually, on February 24th, 2016 there was a remix posted as a part of the "Wavy Wednesdays" series leading up to the release of the "Cozy Tapes: Vol. 1 Friends -" album release, as previously stated the song's arrangement is different as on the remix Rocky goes before A$ton as on this version he goes after A$AP Twelvvy.
